question:
Re-read each record against its first-party page and establish the values its unknown classes name, at least the retention and per-object-cap notes, plus any interface, chaining, retention, per-object-cap or egress value listed for it.
An audit of the first attempt judged these claims unsupported by their sources; settle each one first:
- storage/hostbrr-storagebox-16tb $.retention.notes: 7-day guarantee and absence of a retention period hold, but 'files persist under the renter's control until the plan ends' is not on the page.
- storage/hosting-by-design-app-hosting-24-tb $.per_object_cap.notes: Table has no SSH or other access method; 'access is over SSH' is not on the captured page (fresh read has the same hash).
- storage/hosthatch-storage-vm $.retention.notes: Page lists backups under 'Upcoming Features', 'Available to customers in select locations in May 2023'; it does not say the VMs offer them now.
- storage/hosting-by-design-app-hosting-24-tb $.per_object_cap.notes: Same as c03: SSH access not stated on page.
- storage/hostbrr-storage-vps-hdd-block $.per_object_cap.notes: Page says 500 GB included; 'configurable in 500 GB steps' (step size) is not stated.
- storage/hosthatch-storage-vm $.per_object_cap.notes: Disk size and bandwidth are listed, but 'renter controls the filesystem through root access' is not on the page.
- storage/hostbrr-storagebox-16tb $.interface: Page names FTP, FTPS, SSH, rSync and browser file manager; 'sftp' and 'rclone' are not on the page.
- storage/hosting-by-design-app-hosting-24-tb $.chaining: FUP part supported; 'SSH access' for the app-hosting box appears in no captured source (app-hosting table, FUP page).
- storage/hostbrr-storagebox-16-tb $.free_tier.stated: Price ($35.50/month, $355.00/year) is not in the capture; Utah and bandwidth are.
- storage/hostbrr-storagebox-16tb $.retention.notes: Same as c01: 'files persist under the renter's control until the plan ends' not on page; cited quote (16 TB ceiling) does not address it.
- storage/hostbrr-storage-vps-hdd-block $.chaining: Location and configurable HDD block supported; 'full root-level block storage' (root access) is not stated.
- storage/hosting-by-design-app-hosting-24-tb $.egress.terms: Tiers and outgoing values match, but the 28TB dedicated tier lists 50Gbit, not 10Gbit+; 'each over a 10Gbit+ uplink' is wrong.
- storage/hostbrr-storage-vps-hdd-block $.per_object_cap.notes: Same as c10: '500 GB steps' not stated.
- storage/hosthatch-storage-vm $.per_object_cap.notes: Same as c13: root access not on page.
- storage/hosthatch-storage-vm $.retention.notes: Same as c05; cited products page does not carry it and the features page lists it as upcoming.
